title: Signal Prepare Manifest
description: Schema for the stage 1 manifest written by signal_prepare.py. Tracks progress, fingerprint, round number, and issues for the mechanical skeleton-building step of Signal Extraction.

status.description: in_progress while batches are being written; complete when all skeletons have been written.

round.description: Round number assigned to all Signal Card skeletons in this run. Determines the R-segment of signal_id (SC-R{round}-NNN).

records_read.description: Number of valid Extraction Records successfully read from the input directory.

total_skeletons.description: Number of Signal Card skeletons to be written across all batches. Equals the number of valid records (1:1 mapping in stage 1).

skeletons_written.description: Number of skeletons written so far.

batches_written.description: Number of batch directories written so far.

batch_size.description: Maximum number of skeletons per batch directory.

last_batch_written.description: Batch number of the last batch written. 0 if no batch has been written yet. Used to resume interrupted runs.

signal_id_counter_at_stage1.description: The highest signal_id sequence number assigned by stage 1. Stage 2 reads this to know where to start allocating additional IDs when splitting one skeleton into multiple Signal Cards.

issues.description: Issues encountered during stage 1. Each entry names the affected record and the issue type.

input_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the input records directory (names + sizes). If the fingerprint changes between runs, the script refuses to continue to prevent mixing outputs from different inputs.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when stage 1 first started.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when stage 1 completed successfully. Null while in progress.

record_id.description: extraction_id of the affected record, or null if the issue is not record-specific.

issue_type.description: Closed enum of issue types registered by stage 1.

detail.description: Human-readable detail about the specific issue.
